kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
wire.summary: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

wire.title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
wire.summary: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

wire.title: 5 simple ways to relieve the aches and pains of sitting at a desk all day
wire.summary: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

wire.title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
wire.summary: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

wire.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
wire.summary: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. 6 in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

wire.title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
wire.summary: President Trump, seeking to reshape the voting map, prompted a rare wave of mid-decade redistricting that gave Republicans a boost for holding the House. But the voters will determine if it works.

wire.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
wire.summary: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.

wire.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
wire.summary: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.

wire.title: Can a dream help you solve a problem? Here's how to try tonight
wire.summary: What can you learn from dreams and how can you remember them and steer them to the topics you wish to dream about. Allison Aubrey and A Martinez discuss the resurgance in dream research and how dreams are a tool for self-discovery.

wire.title: Farm country has beef with Trump as midterms approach
wire.summary: President Trump's attempts to bring beef prices down has potentially backfired politically in several key states.

wire.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
wire.summary: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

wire.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
wire.summary: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

wire.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
wire.summary: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021.

wire.title: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
wire.summary: The attack on the unidentified victim follows a wave of anti-migrants protests in South Africa this year.

wire.title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
wire.summary: A Ukrainian man was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia - one of several such cases in Germany this year.

wire.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
wire.summary: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.
